character: Jura mountain skiing — forested, 65 km downhill, 100+ km cross-country. Cross-country paradise.
name: Monts Jura
description: 110km of pistes, 31 lifts, across 4 sites in the Pays de Gex: Lamoura, Mijoux, Lélex, and La Faucille. Cross-country paradise — 130km+ of Nordic trails alongside the downhill. 40 min from Geneva. Family-friendly, peaceful, cheap. Forested rolling terrain.
